name: What permits are required for custom home construction in Glendale?

mainEntity.name: What permits are required for custom home construction in Glendale?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building a custom home in Glendale requires various permits, typically including planning entitlements, grading permits, building permits (encompassing structural, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical), and potentially specific permits for environmental considerations or hillside construction. The exact requirements depend on the project's scope and location within Glendale. Opus Builders assists clients in navigating this complex permitting process, ensuring all necessary approvals are secured before construction begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Glendale custom homes need planning, grading, and building permits. Opus Builders helps manage this process.
